title: Default theme causes white text on white background on dark GTK+ theme
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**

Dark GTK+3 (used on Gnome specifically) theme set dark-grey background with white text.
This library sets background to white explicitly, but does not set font color, resulting in *white on white*.

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install Gnome 3
2. Enable GTK+3 dark mode (if not enabled)
3. Create a searchbox input
4. Type text into the input

**Expected behavior 💭**
Either don't change background color or also appropriately change font color.

**Screenshots 🖥**
Default dark GTK+3 behavior:
![](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/144181/44470373-c6900f80-a629-11e8-8385-959171860baa.png)

With instantsearch.js:
![](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/144181/44470351-bd06a780-a629-11e8-84b4-7bd00768d145.png)

**Environment:**

* OS: Linux, Gnome with dark GTK+3 theme
* Browser: Firefox
* Version: 62
